A semi-implicit method is proposed for solving a system of nonlinear ordinary and partial di erential equations (ODEs/PDEs), which is obtained from a spatial discretization of a model describing the bio-kinetic processes in a wastewater treatment plant.

the development of a simulation tool for the entire plant that allows for the simulation of continuous sedimentation processes with a short execution time and high reliability.
the simulation of a continuous sedimentation tank in the context of a wastewater treatment plant.
the development of a fast, reliable simulation of the secondary settling tank in wastewater treatment plants.
